title: Will and would
summary: **Will** и **would** не только для будущего: предположения, отказ (**won't / wouldn't**), характерное поведение и привычки, вежливые просьбы и разница между **would** и **used to**.
ru:
## Will за пределами «будущего»
Вы знаете will как маркер будущего. На продвинутом уровне важны другие его значения.
- **Предположение о настоящем:** то, что говорящий считает вероятным:
> That **will** be the postman. — Это, наверное, почтальон.
> They'**ll have** gone to bed by now. — Они, наверное, уже легли.
- **Готовность и отказ:** **will** — «согласен, готов», **won't** — «не желает» (в том числе о вещах):
> I'll carry that for you. — Давайте я понесу.
> The printer **won't** work. — Принтер никак не включается.
- **Типичное поведение и общие истины:**
> Oil **will** float on water. — Масло всегда плавает на воде.
> Accidents **will** happen. — Несчастные случаи неизбежны.
- **Привычка, которая раздражает:** если **will** произносится с ударением, получается «вечно он...»:
> He **WILL** leave his cups in the sink! — Он всё время оставляет чашки в раковине!
- **Вежливые просьбы и распоряжения:** **Will you** pass the salt? — Передайте соль, пожалуйста. / You **will** report to me at nine. (приказ).

## Would: прошлое, вежливость, гипотеза
- **Повторяющееся действие в прошлом.** Как и **used to**, но **would** — только для действий, не для состояний:
> Every summer we **would** stay with my grandmother. — Каждое лето мы гостили у бабушки.
> We **used to** have a dog. (состояние) ~~We would have a dog.~~
- **Отказ в прошлом:** She **wouldn't** answer my questions. — Она отказывалась отвечать на мои вопросы. The door **wouldn't** open. — Дверь никак не открывалась.
- **Раздражающая привычка в прошлом:** He **would** always interrupt me. — Он вечно меня перебивал.
- **Вежливость:** **Would you mind** closing the window? / I **would** say it's too early to tell. — Я бы сказал, что судить пока рано.
- **Гипотеза:** I **would** help you if I could. — Я бы помог, если бы мог.

## If + will: исключение
В условных предложениях после if обычно нет will, но мы можем использовать его для **готовности** (вежливо, формально):
> If you **will** sign here, I'll process the application. — Если вы любезно подпишете здесь... 
> I'd be grateful if you **would** help me. — Буду признателен, если вы поможете.

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~When I was a child I would have a bicycle.~~ → I **had** / **used to have** a bicycle.
- ~~I would call you yesterday, but I forgot.~~ → I **was going to** call you.
- ~~If it will rain, we'll stay home.~~ → If it **rains**, we'll stay home.
- ~~The car didn't would start.~~ → The car **wouldn't** start.
en:
## Will beyond the future
You know will as a future marker. At this level the other meanings matter.
- **Assumption about the present:**
> That **will** be the postman.
> They'**ll have** gone to bed by now.
- **Willingness and refusal** (**won't** can be used of things, too):
> I'll carry that for you.
> The printer **won't** work.
- **Typical behaviour and general truths:**
> Oil **will** float on water.
> Accidents **will** happen.
- **Annoying habits**, when will is stressed:
> He **WILL** leave his cups in the sink!
- **Polite requests and orders:** **Will you** pass the salt? / You **will** report to me at nine.

## Would: past, politeness, hypotheses
- **Repeated past actions.** Like **used to**, but **would** is for actions, not states:
> Every summer we **would** stay with my grandmother.
> We **used to** have a dog. ~~We would have a dog.~~
- **Past refusal:** She **wouldn't** answer my questions. The door **wouldn't** open.
- **Annoying past habits:** He **would** always interrupt me.
- **Politeness:** **Would you mind** closing the window? / I **would** say it's too early to tell.
- **Hypotheses:** I **would** help you if I could.

## If + will: the exception
We do not normally use will after if, but we can use it for **willingness** (polite, formal):
> If you **will** sign here, I'll process the application.
> I'd be grateful if you **would** help me.

## Common mistakes
- ~~When I was a child I would have a bicycle.~~ → I **had** / **used to have** a bicycle.
- ~~I would call you yesterday, but I forgot.~~ → I **was going to** call you.
- ~~If it will rain, we'll stay home.~~ → If it **rains**, we'll stay home.
- ~~The car didn't would start.~~ → The car **wouldn't** start.
structure:
## Формулы и значения
| Значение | Форма | Пример |
|---|---|---|
| предположение | will + V / will have + V3 | That **will** be Tom. / They'**ll have** left. |
| готовность | will + V | I'**ll** help. |
| отказ (настоящее) | won't + V | He **won't** listen. |
| типичное поведение | will + V | Dogs **will** bark at strangers. |
| раздражающая привычка | **WILL** + V | She **will** talk! |
| повторяющееся в прошлом | would + V | We **would** swim every morning. |
| отказ в прошлом | wouldn't + V | The engine **wouldn't** start. |
| вежливая просьба | would you (mind) ...? | **Would you** open the door? |

## Would и used to
| Значение | used to | would |
|---|---|---|
| повторяющееся действие | **used to** play chess | **would** play chess |
| состояние (have, be, live, know) | **used to** live here | ~~would live here~~ |
| нужно ли указание на время | нет | обычно да (every summer, always) |

## Отрицание и вопрос
> I **won't** / **wouldn't** go. — **Will** you help? **Would** you mind?
> **Won't** you sit down? (предложение) — **Wouldn't** you agree? (мягкое мнение)
> If you **will** … (вежливо) / If you **would** … (очень вежливо)

exercises.title: Will, won't, would, wouldn't
exercises.instruction: Вставьте will, won't, would или wouldn't (или краткую форму).

items.text: I've asked her three times, but she {{won't|will not}} listen.
The car {{wouldn't|would not}} start this morning, so I took the bus.
You {{will|'ll}} be tired after such a long flight.
When we were kids, we {{would|used to}} spend every summer at our grandmother's farm.
He {{will}} keep leaving his dirty cups in the sink. It drives me mad!

exercises.title: Подберите форму
exercises.instruction: Вставьте подходящую форму с will или would. Допустимые варианты засчитываются.

items.text: Every evening my grandfather {{would sit|would sit down|used to sit}} on the porch and watch the trains.
The new printer {{won't|will not}} work with my laptop, whatever I try.
I asked him to help, but he {{wouldn't|would not}} lift a finger.
Accidents {{will}} happen, so don't blame yourself.
My neighbour {{would|used to}} play the drums at midnight; it drove us crazy.
It's very late. They {{will have|'ll have}} gone to bed by now, so don't phone.

items.q: My brother ___ talk for hours if you let him.
When I was little, we ___ a dog called Bruno.
items.why: **have** здесь состояние (владение), поэтому **had** или used to have, но не would.

items.q: She ___ answer the phone; it just rang and rang.
'Who's at the door?' 'That ___ be Tim; he said he'd come round.'
I'd be grateful if you ___ help me with this form.
He ___ always leave his keys in the car when we were students.
Accidents ___ happen, even to careful people.
Какое предложение подчёркивает характерную, часто раздражающую привычку?
options: He will leave dirty cups everywhere.
He leaves dirty cups everywhere now.
I would have a bike when I was a boy.
I used to have a bike when I was a boy.
I had a bike when I was a boy.
items.why: Для состояний (have) would в значении привычки не используется.

options: Would you mind closing the door?

items.q: Какое предложение выражает отказ в прошлом?
options: She didn't have to sign the papers.

exercises.title: Перепишите с will / would
exercises.instruction: Перепишите предложение, используя слово в скобках.

items.prompt: It's typical of him to leave his phone everywhere. (will) → He ...
answers: He will leave his phone everywhere.
He will always leave his phone everywhere.
He'll always leave his phone everywhere.

items.prompt: As a child, I often went fishing with my father. (would) → As a child, I ...
answers: As a child, I would often go fishing with my father.
As a child, I'd often go fishing with my father.
As a child, I would go fishing with my father.
As a child, I'd go fishing with my father.

items.prompt: The engine refused to start. (wouldn't) → The engine ...
Please open the window. (Would you mind) → Would you mind ...
answers: Would you mind opening the window?
Would you mind opening the window

items.prompt: I'm sure that's Mark at the door. (will) → That ...
answers: That will be Mark at the door.
That'll be Mark at the door.

items.prompt: She refuses to listen to advice. (won't) → She ...
answers: She will not listen to advice.

exercises.title: Напишите о себе
exercises.instruction: Ответьте полными предложениями, используя will или would.

items.prompt: What would you do every summer when you were a child?
items.sample: Every summer we would go to a lake and swim all day.

items.prompt: Describe an annoying habit of someone you know (use will).
items.sample: My colleague will always talk loudly on the phone.

items.prompt: Write about something that wouldn't work or start recently.
items.sample: My laptop wouldn't turn on this morning.

items.prompt: Write a very polite request to a neighbour (would you mind ...).
items.sample: Would you mind turning the music down a little?

items.prompt: Make an assumption about who is calling you right now (will be).
items.sample: That will be my sister; she always calls on Sundays.

items.prompt: Write about a quality of a person you know using 'will' (typical behaviour).
items.sample: My grandmother will always give you something to eat, even if you've just had lunch.
